criterion: Criterion 2. The answer reports that this workspace's external sources were never read: it says the connectors or feeds are not connected, unchecked or stale, or that nothing behind the figures came from outside what people typed into Margince. Answer no if the answer says nothing at all about the state of the sources — reporting only the findings the checks produced is the failure this criterion exists for. Any wording or language will do, and stating it as a denial ('none of the sources were checked') is a yes.
answer:
Two things, and the second matters more than the first.

First, the last nightly run turned up no open findings. That reads as good news and is not.

Second, every external feed is still sitting unconnected. Nothing has ever been read from outside this workspace, so a quiet customer and a dead connector look identical from in here — and the quarterly figures cover what your people typed into Margince, nothing more.
